generator_cmd: bash zpack_gen.sh zpack_b64_bz2_wrapped.bin b64-bz2 "$J4"   # J1..J6 = expected_config JSON (compact); blob: printf header + crc32 from gzip trailer; stream: gzip/bzip2/xz/zlib-flate + coreutils base64 / xxd -p
oracle_cmd: bash zpack_oracle.sh zpack_b64_bz2_wrapped.bin b64-bz2   # strings/grep -bo + base64 -d / xxd -r -p + gzip/bzip2/xz/zlib-flate; prints off at+N magic len hdrcrc crc32(body) body
